description: This file defines the DeviceUser class that implements the User interface for device authentication and authorization within the Eclipse Hono project. It extends the Device class and provides methods for authorization checks and cache clearing.

classes.name: DeviceUser
classes.description: Implements the User interface to represent a device as an authorized user for authentication and authorization purposes in the system.

methods.name: DeviceUser
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a DeviceUser instance with tenant and device IDs.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if the device has a specific authority, returning a Future result indicating success or failure.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Placeholder method for clearing cache, returning null as cache management is not needed.

methods.name: setAuthProvider
methods.description: Sets the AuthProvider, but implementation is a no-op since JWT tokens are self-contained.
